cad.room.title: Use a closed polyline of the drawing as the room
cad.room.note: Lists the closed polylines of the drawing (the ones you have selected first). Its outline becomes the job's room; blocks named like doors and windows near its edge become openings. Arcs in the polyline are cut into short chords.
cad.room.name: Room on layer {layer}
cad.draw.title: Shop drawings in the drawing
cad.draw.note: Draws the plan, an elevation of every run (one block per cabinet type), a section of every template, the schedule, the cut list and the nested sheets as CAD entities on {layers} CC- layers, each sheet in a frame with a title, in the drawing's units. One undo step; Redraw replaces the earlier drawing. They go out in DXF and DWG like anything else.
cad.draw.label: CabinetCraft shop drawings
cad.erase.label: CabinetCraft: erase the sheets
cad.count: {n} entities of this job are in the drawing.
cad.none: Nothing of this job is drawn yet.
cad.cmd.draw: CabinetCraft: draw the shop drawings of the job
cad.3d.title: Cabinets on the 3D tab
cad.3d.note: Puts every cabinet on the 3D tab as a solid (one group each, tag CabinetCraft), for looking at; they are not a CAD model of the panels.
cad.3d.unavailable: This CadCraft has no solids on the 3D tab for add-ons.
cad.cmd.room: CabinetCraft: use the selected closed polyline as the room
